review_evidence: README identifies this repository as the Rocq standard library. All 904 current primary formal-source files were inventoried; 707 own common declaration forms, totaling about 22,162 declarations, including dense developments in Lists, Reals, FSets, integer arithmetic, modular arithmetic and algebra tactics.

The 197 declaration-light files include subcomponent import/navigation modules and source-level compatibility/tactic/test modules; their module paths and import topology remain formal search/navigation signals and no exact subset was proven lossless to remove.
Representative retained sources include theories/Lists/List.v, theories/Reals/RIneq.v, theories/FSets/FMapAVL.v and theories/ZArith/BinInt.v.
summary: Retain the Rocq standard library formal corpus; no exact source-local hard exclusion was established losslessly.
